**Premium** account (Lee'Delle's shop is in the premium area of Rookgaard).

Go to the {creature:Wasp|wasps} tower, in the **northwest** of Rookgaard.
Use the {item:Rope} to climb the tower, killing or simply ignoring the wasps you meet.
The wasps poison: bring potions if you're a very low level.
At the top, **use** the {item:Honeyflower Patch} on the right. You receive a {item:Honey Flower}.
Go back down the way you came up: enter the holes where you used the {item:Rope} until you're back on the tower's ground floor. Then head **southeast** to {npc:Lee'Delle}'s shop.
Go to {npc:Lee'Delle}'s shop, in the **premium** area of Rookgaard. Say {key:hi} and {key:honey flower}. She keeps the flower and gives you a pair of {item:Studded Legs}.
